changes.new_text: The car manufacturer shall declare that during the test, a special charge procedure has not occurred.
changes.reason: Paragraph Annex 8 3.2.2.5.1 of UN R101 was amended in version 1.13.0: 'car' was added.

changes.new_text: The vehicle shall be prepared according to the procedure in paragraph 5.2.2. of Annex 7 to this Regulation.

changes.new_text: Where there are several possible methods to perform a normal AC charge (e.g. cable, induction, etc.), the charging procedure via cable shall be used.
changes.reason: Paragraph Annex 8 3.2.2.5 of UN R101 is new in version 1.13.0: 'Where there are several possible methods to perform a normal AC charge (e.g. cable, induction, etc.)…'.

changes.new_text: Where there are several AC charging power levels available, the highest normal charging power shall be used.
changes.reason: Paragraph Annex 8 3.2.2.5 of UN R101 is new in version 1.13.0: 'Where there are several AC charging power levels available, the highest normal charging power shall …'.

changes.new_text: Charging procedure The REESS shall be charged at an ambient temperature compromised between 20°C and 30°C with the on-board charger if fitted.
changes.reason: Paragraph Annex 8 3.2.2.5.1 of UN R101 is new in version 1.13.0: 'Charging procedure The REESS shall be charged at an ambient temperature compromised between 20°C and…'.

changes.new_text: In the following cases, a charger recommended by the manufacturer and using the charging pattern prescribed for normal charging shall be used if: (a) No on-board charger is fitted, or (b) Charging time exceeds maximum time defined in paragraph 3.2.2.5.2.
changes.reason: Paragraph Annex 8 3.2.2.5.1 of UN R101 is new in version 1.13.0: '(a) No on-board charger is fitted, or (b) Charging time exceeds maximum time defined in paragraph 3.…'.

changes.new_text: The accuracy of these data shall be demonstrated to the approval authority.
